example: The rugged highland terrain restricted trade but provided natural defenses against foreign invasions. (崎嶇的高地地形限制了貿易，但也提供了抵禦外敵入侵的天然防禦。)
The term hillbilly was historically used to describe isolated residents of the Appalachian mountain region. (「山民」一詞在歷史上被用來形容阿帕拉契山脈地區與世隔絕的居民。)
The rugged hilly highland terrain restricted large-scale agricultural plow setup but offered natural fortification defense lines. (崎嶇多丘陵的高地地形限制了大規模農業犁作的配置，但提供了天然的防禦工事防線。)
The hind legs of frogs are highly elongated and muscular, adapted specifically for leaping long distances. (青蛙的後腿高度延伸且肌肉發達，特別適應於長距離跳躍。)
The coastal metropolis relied heavily on agricultural goods shipped from its sprawling rural hinterland. (這座沿海大都市高度依賴從其延伸的農村腹地運送過來的農產品。)
Historically, major demographic urban expansions have been tightly synchronized with breakthroughs in agricultural tools. (歷史上，重大的城市人口擴張都與農業工具的突破高度同步。)
Despite a minor technical hitch during the opening sequence, the theatrical performance was a massive success. (儘管在開場片段發生了輕微的技術小故障，這場戲劇演出還是取得了巨大的成功。)
During the supply shortage, some individuals began to hoard canned food. (在物資短缺期間，一些人開始囤積罐頭食品。)
The farmer used a hoe to remove weeds from the vegetable garden. (農夫用鋤頭清除菜園裡的雜草。)
The clinic advocates a holistic approach to medicine, treating both body and mind. (該診所倡導整體醫療方法，同時治療身體和心靈。)
The historical castle was built securely on a small river holm, protecting it from sudden land assaults. (這座歷史悠久的城堡被牢固地建造在一個河流小島上，使其免受突如其來的陸地襲擊。)
The modern art exhibition paid homage to the pioneering cubist works of Pablo Picasso. (這場現代藝術展向巴勃羅·畢卡索開創性的立體主義作品表達了敬意。)

meaning: 樸素的；平淡無奇的；（美）相貌平平的
example: The restaurant was decorated in a homely style, making customers feel as though they were dining in their own kitchens. (這家餐廳裝潢風格樸素溫馨，讓顧客感覺彷彿在自家廚房用餐一樣。)

meaning: 家庭主婦；家務管理工作者
example: Sociologists tracked how the expansion of automated home appliances altered the traditional work footprint of the urban homemaker. (社會學家追蹤了自動化家用電器的擴張，如何改變城市家庭主婦（家務管理者）的傳統工作足跡。)
The sociologists analyzed how the standardization of the industrial workweek shifted traditional family homemaking dynamics. (社會學家分析了工業工作週的標準化如何改變傳統家庭的家務管理動態。)
Pioneer families wore coarse, unadorned homespun garments handcrafted utilizing raw flax or woolen strands. (拓荒家庭穿著粗糙、無裝飾的手織的（樸素的）衣服，是利用亞麻原料或羊毛纖維手工製作的。)
The government provided free land parcels to any pioneer who could build a permanent homestead and cultivate the soil. (政府向任何能夠建造永久農莊並耕作土地的拓荒者，提供免費的土地地塊。)

meaning: （依據宅地法取得土地的）拓荒農場主
example: Each western homesteader had to construct a permanent stone homestead and cultivate sparse fields to secure legal title. (每位西部拓荒農場主都必須建造一個永久的石造農莊並耕作稀疏的田地，以獲得法律所有權。)

meaning: 有返回原處本能的；導引的
example: Homing pigeons possess an extraordinary biological navigation ability to find their way across thousands of miles. (信鴿具有非凡的生物導航能力，能在數千英哩之外找到回家的路。)
The discovery of early hominid footprints in volcanic ash provided proof of upright bipedal locomotion. (在火山灰中發現的早期原始人類足跡，提供了直立雙足移動的證據。)
The evolution of the genus Homo is marked by substantial cranial enlargement and progressive tool utilization. (人屬的演化以顯著的顱骨擴大和漸進的工具利用為標記。)
The study examines the biological and social aspects of homosexuality. (這項研究探討了同性戀的生物與社會層面。)
The honeybee functions as a critical ecological pollinator, supporting the reproductive cycles of diverse wild angiosperms. (蜜蜂充當關鍵的生態授粉者，支持著多種野生被子植物的繁殖週期。)
The Hopewell culture is renowned for constructing monumental earthworks and maintaining vast trade networks. (霍普威爾文化以建造宏偉的土方工程和維持廣大的貿易網絡而聞名。)
The industrial agricultural processing plant utilized a massive metal hopper to feed grain into the milling machine. (工業農業加工廠利用一個巨大的金屬漏斗，將穀物餵入磨粉機中。)
The endocrine organs secrete volatile chemical compounds that regulate systematic hormonal variations inside mammals. (內分泌器官分泌揮發性化學化合物，以調節哺乳動物內部的系統性荷爾蒙變化。)
The park rangers patrolled the rugged terrain of the national park on horseback to minimize environmental impact. (公園巡邏員騎在馬背上巡邏國家公園的崎嶇地形，以儘量減少對環境的影響。)
The canyon loop forms a spectacular horseshoe bend carved out by millions of years of river erosion. (該峽谷迴圈形成了一個壯觀的馬蹄形彎，是由數百萬年的河流侵蝕所雕琢出來的。)
Early societies practiced small-scale horticulture using hand tools before developing intensive agriculture with plows. (早期社會在發展出使用犁的密集農業之前，先使用手工工具進行小規模的園藝耕作。)
The urban geographer analyzed how the expansion of intercity rail stations boosted the economic fortune of the metropolitan hotelkeeper class. (城市地理學家分析了城市間火車站的擴張，如何提升了大都市旅館老闆階級的經濟財富。)
Wild huckleberry shrubs thrive in the acidic soils of northern temperate forests, providing vital summer food for bears. (野生越橘灌木在北方溫帶森林的酸性土壤中茂盛生長，為熊提供了至關重要的夏季食物。)
Inuit hunters had to huddle inside compacted snow igloos to protect their skin from lethal polar wind gusts. (因紐特獵人不得不聚集成一團擠在緊實的雪屋內部，以保護他們的皮膚免受致命的極地強風吹襲。)
Advanced artificial intelligence software now generates humanlike responses to complex logical queries. (先進的人工智慧軟體現在能針對複雜的邏輯提問生成類似人類的回應。)
The transition toward naturalism in statuary arts emphasized humanness, capturing realistic body weight and emotion. (雕塑藝術向自然主義的過渡強調了人類特徵（人性），捕捉了寫實的身體重量與情感。)
The productivity of textile weaving multiplied hundredfold following the centralization of mechanical steam power inside factories. (在工廠內部集中機械蒸汽動力之後，紡織編織的生產力乘倍增加了百倍。)
Animal husbandry allows pastoralist groups to sustain constant food resources across arid steppe landscapes. (畜牧業（動物馴養）容許畜牧群體跨越乾旱的大草原景觀，維持穩定的食物資源。)
Before mechanical fanners were invented, farmers hand-crushed agricultural grains to isolate the seed from its dry husk. (在機械風選機被發明之前，農民手工壓碎農業穀物，以將種子從其乾燥的外殼中分離出來。)
The streets of New York City are famous for their constant hustle and bustle. (紐約市的街道以其不斷的繁忙和喧囂而聞名。)

meaning: 水文地理的；水道測量的
example: The government surveyor conducted detailed hydrographic mappings to delineate navigable river channels across midcontinent valleys. (政府測量員進行了詳細的水道測量（水文地理的）地圖繪製，以描繪跨越中部大陸山谷的可通航河流通道。)
Deforestation disrupts the regional hydrologic cycle by minimizing plant transpiration and boosting runoff volumes. (砍伐森林藉由將植物蒸散作用降到最低並增加逕流量，破壞了區域的水文循環。)
Persistent overirrigation in semiarid zones alters the deep hydrological table, provoking toxic alkali buildup in topsoil. (半乾旱地區持續的過度灌溉改變了深層的水文水位，在表土中引發了有毒的鹼性累積。)
Modern soilless agriculture setups utilize balanced hydroponic nutrient fluid channels to accelerate crop maturation phases. (現代的無土農業裝置利用平衡的水耕營養液通道，來加速作物的成熟階段。)
Early preindustrial spinning mills were located exclusively near rapids to harvest mechanical hydropower directly. (早期工業化前的紡紗廠完全位於急流附近，以直接收穫機械水力。)
Scientists discovered unique ecosystems surrounding hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor. (科學家在海底熱泉周圍發現了獨特的生態系統。)
In extreme environmental conditions, some animals enter a state of hyper-awareness to detect hidden predators. (在極端的環境條件下，某些動物會進入一種過度警覺的狀態，以偵測隱蔽的捕食者。)
Certain desert plants possess hypersensitive roots that detect minuscule subsurface moisture fluctuations instantly. (某些沙漠植物擁有極度敏感的根部，能立即偵測到地表下微密的水分波動。)
The invention of hypertext allowed web users to navigate seamlessly between interconnected electronic documents. (超文字的發明使網路用戶能夠在互連的電子文件之間進行無縫導覽。)
It is hypocritical of him to lecture others about saving environment. (他對別人演講關於保護環境的事是很虛偽的。)
Astronomers hypothesize that an ancient collision with a proto-planet tilted Uranus drastically on its axis. (天文學家假設，古代與一顆原始行星的撞擊使天王星的自轉軸發生了劇烈傾斜。)
The scientist drafted a hypothetical atmospheric model to simulate how Venus entered a runaway greenhouse cycle. (科學家起草了一個假設的大氣模型，以模擬金星如何進入失控的溫室循環。)

meaning: 北山羊（一種高山野山羊）
example: The alpine ibex possesses specialized rubbery hooves tailored for navigating the most rugged and steep granite cliff faces. (高山北山羊擁有特化的具橡膠感的蹄，專為在最崎嶇陡峭的花崗岩懸崖面上行進而量身定制。)
The ichthyosaur was a highly adapted marine reptile that bore a striking superficial resemblance to modern dolphins. (魚龍是一種高度適應的海洋爬蟲類，外觀上與現代海豚有著驚人的相似之處。)
As spring meltwater seeps through sandstone canyon crevices, it forms a dangling icicle during cold polar nights. (隨著春季融水滲漏過砂岩峽谷裂縫，它在寒冷的極地夜晚會形成一根懸掛的冰柱。)
The art history professor analyzed the iconographic elements present in early medieval religious paintings. (藝術史教授分析了中世紀早期宗教繪畫中所呈現的肖像學元素。)

meaning: 理想主義的、不切實際的
example: The young diplomats brought an idealistic approach to the negotiation table, though veterans warned of pragmatic challenges. (年輕的外交官將理想主義的方法帶到了談判桌上，儘管老手警告說存在務實的挑戰。)
Traditional classical art demanded the strict idealization of aristocratic profiles, rejecting the gritty physical truth of naturalism. (傳統的古典藝術要求將貴族輪廓進行嚴格的理想化，拒絕了自然主義寫實（真實）的身體真相。)
The puritanical religious sect was ideologically rigid, rejecting the mercantile commercialism of the metropolis. (這個清教徒宗教派別在意識形態上非常僵硬，拒絕大都市的商業重商主義。)
The Ouija board phenomenon is often explained by the ideomotor effect. (碟仙現象通常可以用意念運動效應來解釋。)

meaning: 田園詩般的、安逸舒適的
example: The artists spent the summer working in an idyllic countryside cottage surrounded by rolling wildflower hills. (藝術家們整個夏天都在一個被起伏的野花山丘所環繞、如田園詩般美麗的鄉間小屋中工作。)
The traditional igloo features a domelike structure composed of compacted snow blocks that trap internal body heat. (傳統的雪屋具有由緊實雪塊組成的穹頂狀結構，能鎖住內部的身體熱量。)
Extrusive igneous rocks form when molten lava cools rapidly after breaking through Earth's crust. (當熔融的岩漿突破地球地殼並快速冷卻時，就會形成噴出火成岩。)
The introduction of kerosene lamps vastly enhanced indoor illumination during nineteenth-century nighttime hours. (煤油燈的引入大幅增強了十九世紀夜間時段的室內照明。)
The sequential movement created by cinema projectors provides an illusory impression of smooth physical motion to the audience. (電影放映機產生的順序運動，向觀眾提供了一種流暢身體動作的虛幻（錯覺）印象。)
The teacher used an illustrative example to explain the chemical reaction. (老師用了一個說明性的例子來解釋這個化學反應。)
The talented illustrator spent months creating detailed drawings for the new children's encyclopedia. (這位才華橫溢的插畫家花了數月的時間，為新的兒童百科全書創作詳細的插圖。)
The imagist poets broke away from romanticized flowery descriptions, utilizing precise, stark visual imagery. (意象派詩人打破了浪漫化的華麗描述，利用精確、質樸的視覺意象。)
The imagist poetry movement rejected romanticized generalities, prioritizing clear language and precise visual focus. (意象派詩歌運動拒絕浪漫化的籠統概括，優先考慮清晰的語言與精確的視覺焦點。)
An excessive runoff of nitrogen fertilizers can provoke a severe chemical imbalance, triggering algal blooms in waterways. (氮肥的過量逕流會引發嚴重的化學不平衡，在水路中引發藻類大量增殖。)
Ethologists observe imitative behaviors in young primates, who acquire foraging tools by copying parent models. (行為學家在年輕的靈長類動物中觀察到模仿行為，牠們藉由複製親代模範來獲取覓食工具。)
The modernist choreographer rejected classical routines, warning that simple copying transformed a student into a mere mechanical imitator. (這位現代主義編舞家拒絕古典常規，警告說單純的複製會將學生轉化為一個純粹的機械模仿者。)
The physical immaturity of altricial neonates dictates that parent birds must offer prolonged nestling care. (晚熟性新生動物身體上的不成熟，主導了鳥類親代必須提供長期的雛鳥照顧。)
The mechanical output of midwest farmlands multiplied immensely following the historical introduction of the automated reaping system. (在中西部農田歷史性地引入自動化收割系統之後，其機械產量極大地乘倍增加了。)
The physical immersion of clay pots inside waterlogged soil can trigger structural cracking unless protected by a glassy glaze. (陶罐在積水土壤中的物理浸沒會引發結構性龜裂，除非受到玻璃質釉料的保護。)
The behavioral immobility displayed by the camouflaged predatory beetle ensures it remains completely inconspicuous on tree bark faces. (具保護色偽裝的捕食性甲蟲所展現出的行為固定不移（不動），確保了牠在樹皮表面上保持完全不引人注目。)
A specialized forest parasite can bypass the biological immunity parameters of host trees, triggering wide vascular chlorosis. (一種特化的森林寄生蟲能繞過宿主樹木的生物免疫力參數，引發廣泛的維管束萎黃病（缺綠病）。)
Classical art formulas of strict frontality were treated as an immutable sacred law within ancient Egyptian antiquity dynasties. (在古代埃及王朝內部，嚴格正面性的古典藝術公式被視為一條不可變的（不變的）神聖法律。)
The rugged highland alp terrain served as a severe mercantile impediment, restricting intercity railway line expansions. (崎嶇的高山山地地形充當了嚴重的商業阻礙（障礙物），限制了城市間鐵路線的擴張。)
A deep sense of moral duty can impel individuals to risk their lives to rescue strangers from danger. (強烈的道德責任感能驅使個人冒著生命危險從危難中解救陌生人。)
A sudden shift in animal alertness can signal that a catastrophic tectonic earthquake is about to impend. (動物警覺性的突然轉變，可以預示著一場毀滅性的板塊地震即將逼近發生。)
Early mechanical phonographs delivered an imperfect sound reproduction format, carrying chaotic background crackles across cylinders. (早期的機械留聲機提供了一種不完美的聲音重現形式，在圓柱體跨度間夾雜著混沌的背景爆裂聲。)
Early vaudeville theater formats included character impersonation routines that relied heavily on satiric exaggeration. (早期的綜藝雜耍劇院形式包括角色扮演常規表演，高度依賴諷刺性的誇張手法。)

meaning: 不能滲透的、不受影響的
example: The specialized protective safety gear is entirely impervious to highly corrosive industrial chemical acids. (這種專業的防護安全裝備完全無法被高度腐蝕性的工業化學酸液所滲透。)
The newly introduced zoning regulations directly impinge on the traditional property rights of local landholders. (新推出的劃區法規直接侵犯了當地地主傳統的財產權益。)
The desperate refugees gathered outside the embassy to implore the foreign government for political asylum. (絕望的難民聚集在大使館外，懇求外國政府提供政治庇護。)
The centralized mercantile state guild strictly regulated the legal importation of rare foreign mineral pigments like lapis lazuli. (集權的商業國家公會，嚴格監管像青金石這樣稀有外國礦物顏料的合法進口。)
The imposition of heavy agricultural taxes by the centralized state provoked intense unrest among ranchers. (中央集權國家強加沉重的農業稅，在牧場主之間引發了強烈的不安。)
Using imprecise measurements in chemical experiments can lead to completely inaccurate and dangerous results. (在化學實驗中使用不精確的測量可能會導致完全不準確且危險的結果。)
Impressionism broke away from rigid naturalistic formulas, choosing instead to capture subjective optical impressions of light. (印象派打破了僵硬的自然主義公式，轉而選擇捕捉光線的主觀光學印象。)
The impressionist movement focused heavily on capturing the fleeting interplay of light and shadow in naturalistic settings. (印象派運動極度專注於捕捉自然主義場景中光與影稍縱即逝的相互作用。)
The impressionistic art movement prioritized the fleeting Play of light wavelengths, rejecting the rigid outlines of classical naturalism. (印象派藝術運動優先考慮光波長稍縱即逝的遊戲，拒絕了古典自然主義僵硬的輪廓。)
Fossilized leaf imprints provide paleobotanists with information about the canopy density of prehistoric forests. (葉片化石的印記為古植物學家提供了關於史前森林樹冠密度的資訊。)
Vaudeville actors relied on physical improvisation to adjust their comic routines when facing disruptive urban audiences. (綜藝雜耍演員依賴肢體即興表演，以便在面對喧鬧的城市觀眾時調整他們的喜劇常規。)
The glassmaker added specific metallic minerals to clear silicate sand to neutralize any organic iron impurity. (玻璃工匠向清晰的矽酸鹽砂中添加了特定的金屬礦物，以中和任何有機鐵雜質。)
Winter metabolic inactivity allows small burrowing mammals to conserve energy inside frozen tundra biomes. (冬季新陳代謝的不活動狀態（休眠），讓小型築巢哺乳動物能在冰凍的凍原生物群系中節省體能。)
The agricultural inadequacy of the meager steppe harvest forced nomadic pastoralists to drive livestock further afield. (微薄的大草原收成在農業上的不充足，迫使游牧牧民將牲畜趕到更遠的地方。)
The research facility was inadequately funded, which severely limited the scope of its clinical trials. (該研究設施資金不足，這嚴重限制了其臨床試驗的範圍。)
The Inca engineered massive highland agricultural terrace systems that successfully resisted severe soil erosion. (印加人工程建造了大規模的高地農業梯田系統，成功抵抗了嚴重的土壤侵蝕。)
The stellar coma expanding around the comet's core contains volatile gases glowing with an incandescent light under solar rays. (在彗星核心周圍膨脹的恆星彗髮含有揮發性氣體，在太陽光線下發出白熾的光芒。)
The compromised computer security system was entirely incapable of blocking the advanced cyber assault. (這個被攻破的電腦安全系統完全沒有能力阻擋高階的網路攻擊。)
The accident managed to incapacitate the athlete for the entire season. (這場事故使該運動員整個賽季都喪失了參賽能力。)
From its inception, the mercantile trading guild worked legally to centralize urban monopolies and regulate manufacturing taxes. (從創始（開始）起，商業貿易公會就合法地致力於集中城市壟斷並監管製造稅。)
Tidal waves pounded incessantly against the rugged granite seashore, carving out deep erosion gullies. (潮汐波浪連續不斷地敲擊著崎嶇的花崗岩海濱，沖刷出深層的侵蝕沖溝。)

The corporate headquarters featured a modernistic aesthetic defined by clean lines, glass walls, and open layouts. (公司總部呈現出以俐落線條、玻璃牆和開放式格局為特色的現代主義美學。)
The architectural design seamlessly blended traditional cultural motifs with elements of sleek, industrial modernity. (這項建築設計將傳統文化圖騰與時尚的工業現代性元素完美融合。)
The industrial engineer designed a standardized mechanical weaving module to expedite component replacement inside spinning mills. (工業工程師設計了一個標準化的機械編織模組，以加快紡紗廠內部的部件更換速度。)
The two competing nations established a pragmatic diplomatic modus vivendi to avoid open military conflict. (這兩個競爭國家建立了一種務實的外交相處模式，以避免公開的軍事衝突。)
Nineteenth-century commercial shipping farers transported heavy barrels of sugarcane molasses across lucrative maritime trade routes. (十九世紀的商業航海家跨越獲利豐厚的海上貿易路線，運輸沉重的甘蔗糖蜜桶。)
Modern evolutionary science utilizes molecular analysis of DNA sequences to re-map ancient species deviations. (現代演化科學利用DNA序列的分子分析，來重新繪製古代物種的分支圖。)
Arthropods must periodically molt their rigid exoskeletons to accommodate physical growth. (節肢動物必須定期脫去其僵硬的外骨骼，以適應身體的生長。)
Volcanologists collected samples of molten rock as it slowly flowed down the active volcano's slopes. (火山學家在熔岩緩慢流下活火山山坡時採集了岩漿樣本。)
The structural attainment of powered flight by pterosaurs represented a momentous milestone in vertebrate evolutionary prehistory. (翼龍對動力飛行的結構性達成，代表了脊椎動物演化史前史中一個重大的里程碑。)
The historical monastery, built high in the remote mountains, houses a collection of ancient religious scrolls. (這座建在偏遠高山上的歷史修道院，收藏了一系列古代宗教卷軸。)
The nineteenth-century printmaking artisan generated detailed monochrome lithograph profiles capturing industrial factory scenes. (十九世紀的版畫工匠製造了詳細的單色（黑白）石版畫輪廓，捕捉了工業工廠的場景。)

meaning: 一夫一妻制的；單配偶制的
example: Ethological studies demonstrate that specific migratory bird species bird species maintain strictly monogamous mating systems during nesting. (動物行為學研究顯示，特定的遷徙鳥類物種在築巢期間維持著嚴格的一夫一妻制（單配偶制）交配系統。)
During early industrialization, a few mercantile corporate networks worked legally to monopolize intercity railway transit systems. (在工業化早期，少數商業公司網路合法地致力於壟斷城市間鐵路交通系統。)
Incomplete thermal fuel combustion inside preindustrial steam engines releases harmful carbon monoxide gas into urban arcades. (工業化前蒸汽機內部熱量燃料的不完全燃燒，會向城市拱廊街中釋放出有害的一氧化碳氣體。)

meaning: 紀念碑式的；不朽的；宏偉的
example: The construction of monumental architecture like pyramids required centralized political authority and vast labor. (像金字塔這類宏偉建築的建造，需要集中的政治權力和龐大的勞動力。)
A terminal moraine is a ridge of coarse rock debris deposited at the furthest edge of a moving glacier. (終冰磧是在移動冰河的最遠邊緣沉積的粗糙岩石碎屑脊。)
The political essay analyzed the tension between pragmatic realpolitik and abstract moralism in foreign affairs. (這篇政治文章分析了外交事務中務實的現實政治與抽象道德主義之間的緊張關係。)
The literature critic dismissed the novel as excessively moralistic, arguing that it sacrificed character depth for a sermon. (文學評論家認為這部小說過於說教而予以貶低，辯稱它為了說教而犧牲了角色的深度。)
The puritanical religious sect viewed the commercial commercialism of the metropolitan elite as morally bankrupt and corrupt. (這個清教徒宗教派別將大都市精英的商業重商主義，視為在道德上破產與腐敗。)
The bodies of the victims were taken to the local morgue for identification. (受害者的遺體被送往當地的太平間以辨識身分。)
The researchers studied the historical patterns of Mormon migration to the Salt Lake Valley in the mid-19th century. (研究人員研究了19世紀中期摩門教徒遷移至鹽湖谷的歷史模式。)

meaning: 莫里斯 (人名例：威廉·莫里斯)
example: William Morris spearheaded the Arts and Crafts movement, rejecting the rigid unadorned simplification of mass industrialism. (威廉·莫里斯帶頭發起了工藝美術運動，拒絕大規模工業化僵硬、無裝飾的簡化形式。)
Improved healthcare has contributed to a significant decline in infant mortality. (醫療保健的改善有助於嬰兒死亡率的顯著下降。)
The embarrassing mistake managed to mortify him in front of his colleagues. (這個尷尬的錯誤讓他在同事面前感到非常羞愧。)
Expert joiners engineered Pullman sleeping car woodworks using stable mortise and tenon links without metal screws. (專家級的細木工匠利用穩固的榫眼與榫頭連結來工程製造普爾曼臥鋪車廂的木工，而不用金屬螺絲。)
The archaeological excavation revealed a beautifully preserved mosaic floor depicting ancient maritime trade routes. (這項考古挖掘揭示了一個保存精美的馬賽克地板，描繪了古代的海上貿易路線。)
The recurring floral motif in the woven textiles indicates a deep cultural reverence for nature. (織品中反覆出現的花卉圖案，顯示了對大自然的深厚文化崇敬。)
The predatory falcon remained entirely motionless on the cedar branch, relying on camouflage to hide from prey. (捕食性的遊隼在雪松樹枝上保持完全靜止，依賴保護色（偽裝）向獵物隱蔽。)
The amphibian's mottled green and brown skin provided excellent camouflage against the muddy forest floor. (這種兩棲動物斑駁的綠褐色皮膚，在泥濘的森林地面上提供了極佳的偽裝。)

meaning: 發霉的、陳腐的（英式拼法，美式常作moldy）
example: Storing the organic crops in high humidity caused them to become mouldy and entirely unsellable. (將有機作物儲存在高濕度環境中，導致它們發霉且完全無法販售。)
A catastrophic landslide triggered by the torrential rains swept down the steep mountainside, burying the valley below. (暴雨引發的災難性土石流席捲了陡峭的山坡，掩埋了下方的山谷。)
The tropical climate was exceptionally muggy throughout July, making outdoor activities highly uncomfortable. (整個七月，熱帶氣候異常悶熱潮濕，使得戶外活動非常不舒服。)
The Proterozoic eon marks a critical evolutionary breakthrough: the initial rise of stable multicellular life. (元古代標記了一個關鍵的演化突破：穩定多細胞生物的最初興起。)
Modern radar systems employ multidirectional sensors to track multiple airborne targets simultaneously. (現代雷達系統採用多方向的感測器，以同時追蹤多個空中目標。)
The economy experienced a multiplicative growth pattern after the tech boom. (科技繁榮後，經濟經歷了倍增的成長模式。)
The tropical rainforest ecosystem exhibits a spectacular multiplicity of symbiotic alliances among insect groups. (熱帶雨林生態系統在昆蟲群落之間展現出驚人的共生同盟多樣性（多重性）。)

meaning: 活動底片連續放映機（早期電影設備）
example: The mutoscope, which relied on a circular flipbook mechanism, competed directly with Edison's kinetoscope in early arcades. (依靠圓形翻頁書機制的連續放映機，在早期的遊藝場中與愛迪生的活動電影放映機直接競爭。)
The alliance between clownfish and sea anemones is a textbook example of obligate marine mutualism. (小丑魚與海葵之間的結盟，是海洋專性互利共生的教科書範例。)
The government’s short-term focus was criticized as a myopic economic policy. (政府對短期利益的關注被批評為目光短淺的經濟政策。)
The ancient civilization mysteriously vanished from historical records, leaving behind only ruins. (這個古老文明神秘地從歷史記錄中消失了，只留下遺心。)
The complex motifs etched onto archaic earthenware pottery frequently held deep mystical or ritualistic meanings. (雕刻在古老土器陶器上複雜的圖案，經常具有深奧的神秘（宗教儀式）意義。)
The unusual atmospheric phenomenon continued to mystify meteorologists for several decades. (這種不尋常的大氣現象在過去幾十年中，繼續使氣象學家感到困惑。)
The ritualistic trance behaviors executed by the Paleolithic shaman granted the elite class an aura of supernatural mystique. (舊石器時代薩滿所執行的宗教儀式恍惚行為，賦予了精英階級一層超自然的神秘色彩。)
The intricate motifs on early Bronze Age earthenware often depicted battles with powerful mythical beasts. (青銅時代早期土器陶器上複雜的圖案，經常描繪與強大神話野獸的戰鬥。)
The carver etched complex mythological imagery onto the flat limestone slab to decorate the centralized ancestral temple. (雕刻師將複雜的神話意象刻在平坦的石灰岩厚板上，以裝飾集中的祖先神廟。)
The botanist extracted volatile organic chemical compounds from the wild fern that carried a powerful sedative and narcotic asset. (植物學家從野生蕨類植物中提取出揮發性有機化學化合物，該化合物具有強大的鎮靜與麻醉特性。)
The hikers had to proceed carefully as the mountain trail became significantly narrower near the summit. (由於山路在接近山頂處明顯變得更窄，登山客必須小心前進。)
The innovative educational program was nationally recognized for improving secondary literacy standards. (這項創新的教育計畫因提升了中學讀寫能力標準，而獲得了全國性地認可。)

meaning: 自然主義（藝術中的寫實描繪）
example: The Greek transition toward sculptural naturalism captured fluid body motion, breaking away from rigid historic art formulas. (希臘向雕塑自然主義的過渡捕捉了流暢的身體動作，打破了僵硬的歷史藝術公式。)
Greek sculptors transitioned from rigid formulas to naturalistic depictions of human anatomy and movement. (希臘雕刻家從僵硬的公式過渡到對人類解剖結構和運動的寫實描繪。)
The bumpy boat ride made several passengers feel extremely nauseous. (顛簸的船程讓幾名乘客感到非常噁心。)
The expansion of the steamboat depended on developing wide, deep, navigable river pathways across the midcontinent. (汽船的擴張取決於跨越中部大陸開發出寬闊、深邃、可通航的河流路徑。)
Polynesian watercraft masters relied on navigational skills centered on wave swells and avian migratory patterns. (玻里尼西亞船隻大師依賴以海浪湧浪和鳥類遷徙模式為核心的航海技能。)
An expert Polynesian navigator could read invisible ocean currents to pinpoint isolated coral islands. (一位專家級的玻里尼西亞航海家可以讀懂看不見的洋流，以精確指出孤立的珊瑚島。)
Genetic evidence indicates that modern humans and Neanderthals interbred before the latter went extinct. (基因證據顯示，現代人類與尼安德塔人在後者滅絕之前曾進行過雜交。)
The nearness of the residential district to the industrial zone raised immediate public health concerns. (住宅區與工業區的接近，引發了即刻的公共衛生疑慮。)
A planetary nebula is composed of gas and interstellar dust expelled from a dying low-mass star. (行星狀星雲由從步入末期的低質量恆星中排出的氣體和星際塵埃組成。)
A virulent fungal infestation blocks the tree's vascular conductance, causing rapid foliage chlorosis and terminal stem necrosis. (一種具毒性的真菌侵染阻斷了樹木的維管束導度，引起快速的葉子萎黃病與末端莖組織壞死。)
Implementing redundant security protocols resulted in a needless expenditure of both time and financial resources. (實施冗餘的安全協定導致了時間和財政資源上不必要的浪費。)
Anthropologists analyze the intricate geometric needlework on ancestral garments to map kinship alliances. (人類學家分析祖傳服飾上複雜的幾何刺繡，以繪製親屬聯盟圖譜。)
The corporate construction company was found negligent for failing to implement mandatory safety precautions. (該企業建築公司因未能執行強制性安全預防措施而被認定為玩忽職守。)

meaning: 微不足道地；可忽略不計地
example: Although the room temperature fluctuated negligibly throughout the day, the sensitive instruments remained unaffected. (儘管室溫整天下來只有微幅波動，但敏感的儀器並未受到影響。)
The architectural metropolis facade highlighted a neoclassical style, displaying grandiose limestone columns and formal symmetry. (這座大都市建築正面突出了新古典主義風格，展現出宏偉的石灰岩圓柱與正式的對稱性。)
The Neolithic revolution marked a fundamental transition from hunting and gathering to systematic agriculture. (新石器時代革命標誌著從狩獵採集向系統化農業的根本轉變。)
A marsupial neonate is born in an exceptionally underdeveloped state, completing its growth within its mother's pouch. (有袋類新生兒出生時處於異常未發育的狀態，在其母親的育兒袋內完成生長。)

meaning: 安頓；依偎；舒適地坐落於
example: Many ancestral Pueblo villages were designed to nestle deep within defensive sandstone alcoves. (許多祖傳普埃布洛村落的設計都是為了舒適地坐落於具防禦性的砂岩凹處深處。)
The parent birds must constantly forage to satisfy the voracious appetite of each nestling in the brood. (鳥爸媽必須不斷覓食，以滿足巢中每隻雛鳥源源不絕的食慾。)
Phytoremediation utilize specialized hyper-accumulator root secretions to chemically neutralize heavy metal toxins inside contaminated topsoil. (植物修復利用特化的超累積植物根部分泌物，從化學上中和受污染表土內部的重金屬毒素。)
The nucleus of an atom consists of positively charged protons and uncharged neutral neutrons packed tightly together. (原子的原子核由帶正電的質子和不帶電的中性中子緊密結合而成。)

meaning: 紐伯瑞（常指美國兒童文學獎）
example: The author achieved international acclaim after winning the prestigious Newberry Medal for children's literature. (該作者在榮獲享譽盛名的紐伯瑞兒童文學獎後，贏得了國際讚譽。)
The maternal investment in a newborn seal is immense, with the mother providing nutrient-rich milk to maximize growth. (對一隻剛出生的海豹的新生兒投入是巨大的，母海豹提供富含營養的乳汁以最大化其生長速度。)
Due to rising production costs, the publisher switched to a cheaper quality of newsprint for daily editions. (由於生產成本上升，出版商將日報改用較便宜品質的新聞紙印刷。)
The investigative discovery of corporate tax fraud was deemed highly newsworthy by major international media networks. (對公司稅務欺詐的調查性發現，被主要的國際媒體網絡認為極具新聞價值。)
When two species occupy the exact same ecological niche, competitive exclusion typically occurs. (當兩個物種佔據完全相同的生態棲位時，通常會發生競爭排除。)
Nicotine is the highly addictive chemical compound found in tobacco products. (尼古丁是煙草製品中發現的高度成癮性化學化合物。)
Desert wildlife often limits activity to nighttime hours to preserve moisture and avoid daytime hyper-thermia. (沙漠野生動物通常將活動限制在夜間時段，以保持水分並避免白天體溫過高。)
The fertile silt deposited by the Nile's annual floods permitted agriculture to flourish in the desert. (尼羅河每年氾濫所沉積的肥沃淤泥，使得農業能在沙漠中蓬勃發展。)
The mercantile nobility controlled luxury monopolies, commissioning ornate statuary to perpetuate their social dominance. (商業貴族階級控制著奢侈品壟斷，委託製作華麗的雕像以使其社會主導地位永存。)
A legume plant forms specialized root nodule configurations to shelter symbiotic colonies of nitrogen-fixing bacteria. (豆科植物長出特化的根瘤構造，以庇護固氮細菌的共生群落。)
The protesters gathered outside the city hall, noisily demanding immediate environmental reforms. (抗議者聚集在市政廳外，吵鬧地要求立即進行環境改革。)
A pastoral nomad must maintain extensive botanical and hydrological knowledge to locate scattered subsurface water wells. (游牧民必須維持廣泛的植物學與水文學知識，以查明分散的地表下水井位置。)
Before the adoption of agriculture, Paleolithic human groups led a nomadic lifestyle centered on seasonal foraging. (在採用農業之前，舊石器時代的人類群體過著以季節性採集為核心的游牧生活方式。)
Pastoral nomadism represents an adaptation to arid biomes where water sources are ephemeral and widely scattered. (畜牧游牧生活代表了對乾旱生物群系的適應，那裡的資源短暫且分佈廣泛。)
Rapid urbanization inside the industrial metropolis triggered a massive demographic shift toward nonagricultural factory occupations. (工業大都市內部的快速城市化，引發了人口向非農業工廠職業的大規模轉移。)
Despite the immense pressure of the championship match, the athlete maintained a surprisingly nonchalant attitude. (儘管冠軍賽面臨巨大壓力，這位運動員依然保持著令人驚訝的若無其事態度。)

meaning: 不墨守成規、不符合、非國教徒
example: The avant-garde artist's deliberate nonconformity challenged the rigid aesthetic standards of the royal academy. (這位前衛藝術家刻意的不墨守成規，挑戰了皇家學院僵化的美學標準。)
The school emphasizes traditional learning by incorporating nonelectronic educational tools like physical blocks and books. (該學校透過納入實體積木和書籍等非電子的教育工具，來強調傳統學習。)
During the fiscal crisis, the municipal government suspended funding for all nonessential public infrastructure projects. (在財政危機期間，市政府暫停了所有非必要的公共基礎設施專案之資金。)

meaning: 非小說類文學；紀實文學
example: The historical geographer published a comprehensive work of nonfiction detailing how railways reshaped midwest farmlands. (這位歷史地理學家出版了一部詳盡的非小說類紀實著作，詳細描述了鐵路如何重塑中西部農田。)
Traditional Egyptian frontality arts treated stylistic variations as nonfunctional anomalies that violated sacred rules. (傳統的埃及正面性藝術，將風格的變異視為違反神聖規則的無功能異常現象。)
Ethologists study how nonhuman primates utilize rudimentary tools to extract hidden insects from tree bark. (行為學家研究非人類靈長類動物如何利用基本的工具，從樹皮中提取隱藏的昆蟲。)
The ecosystem comprises both living organisms and nonliving environmental components like minerals and water. (生態系統包含生物體和無生命的環境組成部分（如礦物質和水）。)
Unlike sandstone bedrock structures, obsidian is a highly nonporous, nonporous, glassy volcanic rock that blocks fluid infiltration metrics. (與砂岩基岩構造不同，黑曜石是一種高度無孔的（不透水的）、玻璃質火山岩，能阻斷流體滲透指標。)
Biological immunity networks utilize specialized receptor parameters to detect and destroy harmful nonself microbial invaders. (生物免疫網路利用特化的受體參數，來偵測並摧毀有害的非自我（外來）微生物入侵者。)
Modern choreographers introduced nontraditional, naturalistic movements that rejected the rigid posture rules of classical ballet. (現代編舞家引入了非傳統的寫實動作，拒絕了古典芭蕾僵硬的姿勢規則。)
Facial expressions and body language are powerful forms of nonverbal communication that convey genuine emotions. (面部表情與肢體語言是非言語溝通的強大形式，能傳達真實的情感。)
The 1066 Norman Conquest fundamentally transformed the linguistic and political architecture of medieval England. (1066年的諾曼征服徹底改變了中世紀英格蘭的語言與政治結構。)
The northeastern woodlands of America supported sedentary indigenous cultures that engaged in systematic corn agriculture. (美洲的東北部森林地帶支持著從事系統化玉米農業的定居原住民文化。)
Listening to songs from his high school years filled the elderly man with a profound sense of nostalgia. (聆聽高中時期的歌曲讓這位老人在心中充滿了深刻的懷舊情懷。)
Composers use musical scores to notate their complex musical ideas. (作曲家使用樂譜來記錄他們複雜的音樂想法。)
The ancient toolmaker carved a sharp horizontal notch into the cedar shaft to secure the handcraft obsidian flint spearhead. (古代工具製造者在雪松木軸上雕刻出一個銳利的水平V形刻痕，以固定手工藝黑曜石燧石矛頭。)
Following historical volcanic eruptions, global summer temperatures dropped noticeably due to atmospheric sulfate blocks. (在歷史上的火山爆發之後，由於大氣硫酸鹽的阻擋，全球夏季氣溫明顯下降。)

meaning: 惡名昭彰地；聲名狼藉地；眾所周知地
example: Atmospheric systems inside hyper-arid desert basins are notoriously chaotic, rendering daily rainwater forecasting practically impossible. (極度乾旱沙漠盆地內部的大氣系統是眾所周知地（惡名昭彰地）混沌，使得每天的雨水預報在實際上完全不可能。)
Art Nouveau designers rejected traditional historicism, favoring organic curves inspired by plants and flowers. (新藝術派設計師拒絕傳統的歷史主義，青睞受植物和花卉啟發的有機曲線。)

meaning: 現在預報；即時天氣預報

DNA is a complex biological polymer whose sequenced mineral molecular strands encode all hereditary development instructions. (DNA是一種複雜的生物聚合物，其序列化的礦物分子股編碼了所有遺傳發育指令。)

meaning: 玻里尼西亞的；玻里尼西亞人
example: Polynesian seafarers demonstrated exceptional navigational skills, colonizing isolated Pacific islands without magnetic compasses. (玻里尼西亞航海家展現了卓越的航海技能，在沒有磁指南針的情況下拓殖了孤立的太平洋島嶼。)
Music historians trace how early metropolitan theatrical accompaniments transitioned toward complex vocal polyphony formats. (音樂歷史學家追蹤了早期的城市大都市劇場伴奏，如何向複雜的聲樂複音音樂形式過渡。)
Early steam-powered agricultural machinery was exceptionally ponderous, consuming prodigious wood volumes to complete minor work. (早期蒸汽動力的農業機械異常笨重，消耗巨大數量的木材僅能完成微不足道的工作。)

meaning: 橋（常用於法文地名或外來語）
example: The historical text referenced the famous Pont du Gard, an ancient Roman aqueduct bridge in southern France. (這本文獻提及了著名的加爾橋，這是一座位於法國南部的古羅馬輸水隧橋。)
For safety reasons, laboratory personnel with long hair are required to tie it back in a secure ponytail. (出於安全原因，長頭髮的實驗室人員必須將頭髮紮成牢固的馬尾辮。)
Nineteenth-century urban metropolis overcrowding forced destitute immigrant laborers into centralized city poorhouse institutions. (十九世紀城市大都市的過度擁擠，迫使貧困的移民勞工進入集中的城市救濟院機構。)
The fertile river lowlands supported the development of the most populous metropolitan centers of antiquity. (肥沃的河流低地支持了古代人口最稠密的大都市中心的發展。)
The exceptional porosity of sandstone makes it an excellent reservoir rock for absorbing migrating groundwater. (砂岩優異的孔隙率使其成為吸收流動地下水的極佳儲集岩。)
The lightweight portability of bark canoes allowed migratory forager tribes to travel swiftly across river networks. (樹皮獨木舟輕巧的可攜性，容許遷移的採集部落在河流網路中迅速旅行。)
Severe tectonic fault stresses and subsurface magma upwelling anomalies often portend an onrushing volcanic eruption. (嚴重的板塊斷層應力與地表下岩漿湧出異常，經常預示著一場洶湧而來的火山爆發。)
The nineteenth-century portraitist transitioned to realist styles, rejecting romanticized generalities to capture authentic facial lines. (十九世紀的肖像畫家過渡到寫實主義風格，拒絕浪漫化的籠統概括，以捕捉真實的面部線條。)
Realist portraiture broke away from romanticized aristocratic profiles, prioritizing the gritty visual truth of working-class laborers. (寫實主義肖像畫藝術打破了浪漫化的貴族輪廓，優先考慮工人階級勞工真實的視覺真相。)
Realist painters prioritized the gritty, naturalistic portrayal of urban laborers enduring long workdays. (寫實主義畫家優先考慮對忍受漫長工作日的城市勞工，進行真實、自然主義的描繪。)
Evolutionary sociobiologists posit that the division of labor in honeybee colonies is genetically encoded. (演化社會生物學家假定，蜜蜂群落中的勞動分工是經過基因編碼的。)
The academic department offers several postgraduate scholarships to support advanced doctoral research. (該學系提供了數個研究生獎學金，以支持高階的博士研究。)
The author received a posthumous award for his contribution to literature. (這位作者因其對文學的貢獻而獲得了死後追授的獎項。)
The heroic soldier was posthumously awarded the Medal of Honor for his extraordinary bravery during the battle. (這位英勇的士兵因其在戰鬥中非凡的勇氣而被追授榮譽勳章。)

meaning: 後現代的、後現代主義的
example: The building's architecture is a classic example of postmodern design, mixing historical motifs with bold geometry. (這棟建築的結構是後現代設計的經典範例，將歷史圖案與大膽的幾何圖形混合在一起。)
Potash is mined extensively for use in agricultural fertilizers to promote strong root growth in crops. (碳酸鉀被廣泛開採，用於農業肥料中以促進作物強壯的根部生長。)
Potassium-argon dating is a critical geochemical tool used to measure the age of ancient volcanic layers. (鉀-氬定年法是用於測量古代火山層年齡的關鍵地球化學工具。)
Scientists are exploring the full potentiality of stem cell therapy to cure chronic genetic illnesses. (科學家正在探索幹細胞療法在治療慢性基因疾病方面的全部潛力。)
In ancient folklore, the witch brewed a magical potion intended to grant eternal youth to anyone who drank it. (在古代民間傳說中，女巫調製了一種魔法藥水，旨在賜予任何喝下它的人永恆的青春。)
Earth's magnetosphere interacts powerfully with solar winds, deflecting electronic plasma molecules from atmospheric borders. (地球的磁層與太陽風強有力地互動，偏轉大氣邊界處的電子電漿分子。)
Environmental scientists monitor the atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration, which has now exceeded 420 ppm. (環境科學家監測大氣中的二氧化碳濃度，該濃度目前已超過420ppm。)
The economic practicality of manufacturing mechanized piecework commodities boosted labor specialization throughout northeastern cities. (製造機械化計件商品的經濟實用性（可行性），促進了整個東北部城市的勞工專業分工。)
In the hyper-arid core of the Sahara desert, rainfall is practically nonexistent for multiple consecutive years. (在撒哈拉沙漠的極度乾旱核心地區，連續多年幾乎完全沒有降雨。)

meaning: 大草原（特指北美大草原）
example: The sprawling midwest prairies feature fine, rich soils that support expansive commercial grain farmlands. (蔓延的中西部大草原以細緻、肥沃的土壤為特色，支持著廣闊的商業穀物農田。)
The diplomatic envoys met in a neutral territory to prearrange the formal terms of the peace treaty. (外交使節在中立領土會面，以預先安排和平條約的正式條款。)
Migratory pastoralist groups lead a precarious subsistence life heavily dependent on seasonal rain predictability. (游牧牧民過著不穩定的維持生存生活，高度依賴季節性降雨的可預測性。)
As a precautionary measure, the coastal city evacuated low-lying residential neighborhoods before the hurricane made landfall. (作為預防措施，這座沿海城市在颶風登陸前撤離了低窪住宅區。)
Heavy predation pressures by invasive fish can force native lake invertebrates into deep subsurface niches. (入侵魚類沉重的捕食壓力，會迫使原生湖泊無脊椎動物進入深層的地表下生態棲位。)
The development of forward-facing eyes enhances depth perception, a trait common among predatory birds. (前向眼睛的發展增強了深度知覺，這是捕食性鳥類中常見的特徵。)
Classical Egyptian relief arts conformed rigidly to a predetermined geometric grid formula of strict frontality. (古典埃及浮雕藝術，僵硬地符合嚴格正面性的一種預先決定的幾何網格公式。)
The agrarian communities faced a severe subsistence predicament when successive monsoons failed to prompt rain recharges. (當接連的季風未能促成雨水補給時，農業社群面臨了嚴重的維持生存困境。)
The annual predictability of Nile River floods allowed ancient Egyptian agriculturalists to flourish despite desert barriers. (尼羅河每年氾濫的可預測性，容許古代埃及農業勞動者儘管面對沙漠屏障仍能繁榮發展。)

meaning: 使預先有傾向；使易受感染
example: A total lack of genetic variability can predispose a specialized angiosperm population to sudden fungal infestations. (完全缺乏基因變異性會使特化的被子植物族群，易受（預先有傾向）突然的真菌侵染。)
Mycorrhizal fungal systems maintain preferential nutrient trading rules, exchanging soil phosphorus for host carbohydrates. (菌根真菌系統維持著優先的營養交易規則，用土壤中的磷交換宿主的碳水化合物。)
Mycorrhizal fungal networks preferentially exchange gathered soil minerals for plant-synthesized carbohydrates. (菌根真菌網路優先地將採集到的土壤礦物質，用於交換植物合成的碳水化合物。)
Paleolithic toolmakers would preform raw flint blocks into basic blank slabs before knapping sharp scrapers via percussion. (舊石器時代的工具製造者在透過敲擊加工出鋒利的刮削器之前，會先將原始燧石塊預先形成為基礎的空白厚板。)
Because Paleolithic human societies lacked writing systems, our knowledge of prehistory depends exclusively on archaeological extraction. (由於舊石器時代的人類社會缺乏文字系統，我們對史前時代的知識完全依賴於考古挖掘。)
In preindustrial societies, mercantile trade depended heavily on animal transport watercraft and horse stagecoaches. (在工業化前的社會中，商業貿易高度依賴動物運輸、水上船隻與馬車驛馬車。)

meaning: 尚無文字的；文字前期的
example: Anthropologists analyze cave drawings and oral traditions to study the social structures of preliterate societies. (人類學家分析洞穴壁畫和口述傳統，以研究文字前期社會的社會結構。)
The minor diplomatic skirmish was a tragic prelude to the full-scale international war that followed. (這場小規模的外交衝突，是隨後爆發的全面國際戰爭的悲慘序幕。)

meaning: 全神貫注；成見；專注的事物
example: The continuous historic preoccupation of ancient Egyptian art with strict frontality reflected rigid spiritual values regarding the afterlife. (古埃及藝術對嚴格正面性的持續歷史專注的事物，反映了關於來世的僵硬精神價值觀。)
Before stratigraphic evidence Substantiated plate movement, the concept of a single Pangaea landmass was labeled preposterous. (在地層證據證實板塊運動之前，單一盤古超大陸陸塊的概念被標記為荒謬的。)
Before digital systems arose, early audio engineers utilized mechanical cylindrical phonographs to prerecord acoustic signals. (在數位系統興起之前，早期的音訊工程師利用機械圓柱形留聲機來預先錄製聲音訊號。)
Climatologists warn that severe seasonal rain droughts could presage wide topsoil degradation anomalies. (氣候學家警告說，嚴重的季節性降雨乾旱可能預示著廣泛的表土退化異常現象。)
Developmental psychologists test preschool children to trace how imitative interactions shape language tool maturation. (發展心理學家對學齡前（幼兒園）兒童進行測試，以追蹤模仿互動如何塑造語言工具的成熟。)
Developmental psychologists study the cognitive tools a preschooler uses to solve basic spatial puzzles. (發展心理學家研究學齡前兒童用來解決基本空間謎題的認知工具。)
Early Neolithic tribes combined harvested acorns with bitter tannins, which functioned as a natural organic preservative. (早期新石器時代部落將收割的橡實與苦澀的單寧相結合，單寧充當了一種天然的有機防腐劑。)
The satiric playwright composed dramas that mocked the cultural pretension and protectionist greed of the mercantile urban elite. (這位諷刺劇作家創作了嘲弄城市商業精英文化自負（傲慢）與保護主義貪婪的戲劇。)
The extensive prevalence of symbiotic mycorrhizal fungal relationships among angiosperms accelerated their global radiation expansion. (共生菌根真菌關係在被子植物中的廣泛普遍（盛行），加速了牠們在全球範圍內的輻射擴張。)
The ancient Mayan hieroglyphic inscriptions record that a royal priestess coordinated ceremonial calendar rituals inside cavern locations. (古代馬雅象形文字銘文記載，一位皇家女祭司在溶洞地點內部協調了儀式性的曆法祭典。)
The shaman's trance ritual was driven by a primal urge to protect the agrarian village from unpredictable droughts. (薩滿的恍惚儀式是由一種原始的衝動所驅動的，旨在保護農業村莊免受不可預測的乾旱侵害。)
Through her pioneering work in primatology, Jane Goodall revolutionized our understanding of chimpanzee behavior. (透過在靈長類動物學方面的開創性研究，珍古德徹底改變了我們對黑猩猩行為的理解。)
Primitive stony chondrites offer researchers a pristine sample of Earth's primordial planetary building blocks. (原始的石質球粒隕石為研究人員提供了地球原始行星建築區塊的原始樣本。)
The ecological diet of the coastal bird population consists principally of small fish caught near the marine seabed surface. (沿海鳥類族群的生態飲食，主要由在海洋海床表面附近捕捉的小魚組成。)
The evolution of woodcut printmaking permitted publishers to mass-produce complex visual blueprints alongside text inscriptions. (木刻版畫複製術的演化，容許出版商在文字銘文旁大量生產複雜的視覺藍圖。)
Early urban metropolis entertainment included the prizefight, drawing laborers into centralized sports arcades. (早期城市大都市的娛樂活動包括職業拳擊賽，將勞工吸引到集中的體育拱廊街中。)

meaning: 積極主動的；先發制人的
example: Taking a proactive approach to cybersecurity can prevent major data breaches before they occur. (採取積極主動的網路安全策略，可以在重大資料外洩發生之前將其阻止。)
The woolly mammoth consumed a prodigious volume of steppe grass daily to fuel its substantial metabolic systems. (長毛象每天消耗巨大數量的草原牧草，以維持其龐大的新陳代謝系統。)
The educational reform movement enhanced teacher training, boosting standard literacy metrics via academic professionalism. (教育改革運動加強了教師培訓，透過學術專業化提升了標準的讀寫指標。)
To qualify for the advanced translation position, applicants must speak at least three languages proficiently. (為了符合高階翻譯職位的資格，申請人必須熟練地講述至少三種語言。)
The tropical coral reef displays a spectacular profusion of marine life and vibrant biological structures. (熱帶珊瑚礁展示了極其豐富且壯觀的海生生物與充滿活力的生物結構。)

meaning: （費用等）高昂得辦不到的；禁止的
example: The monetary costs of establishing automated steam turnpikes became prohibitive for early mercantile private capitalists. (建立自動化蒸汽收費公路的資金成本，對早期的商業私營資本家來說變得高昂得辦不到。)
The invention of the cinematic projector permitted moving images to be displayed to a large, gathered audience. (電影放映機的發明使得動態畫面能夠展示給大量聚集的觀眾觀看。)
There is a pronounced difference between the two statistical models. (這兩個統計模型之間存在著明顯的差異。)
Research indicates that certain behavioral traits increase an individual's propensity for taking economic risks. (研究表明，某些行為特質會增加個人承擔經濟風險的傾向。)
As a mammalian primate fetus undergoes cranial maturation inside the womb, its frontal lobe scales upward proportionally. (隨著哺乳動物靈長類胎兒在子宮內進行顱骨成熟，其額葉會成比例地按比例放大。)
As an animal's physical weight scales upward, its structural skeletal thickness must multiply proportionately. (隨著動物身體重量的按比例上升，其結構骨骼厚度必須成比例地乘倍增加。)
Squids utilize jet propulsion, forcefully expelling water from a siphon to accelerate away from danger. (烏賊利用噴射推進，從虹吸管中強烈排出水流，以加速逃離危險。)
An independent pioneer prospector mapped out the southwestern desert, searching for potash and manganese veins. (一位獨立的拓荒探礦者繪製了西南部沙漠的圖表，尋找碳酸鉀與錳礦脈。)

meaning: 平臥的；（植物）伏地的；倒下的
example: Above the alpine timberline, high-velocity airstreams force resilient shrubs to adapt a low-growing, prostrate profile. (在高山林木線以上，高速的氣流迫使具恢復力的灌木適應低矮生長、伏地的輪廓。)
In classical literature, the protagonist frequently undergoes a transformative psychological journey. (在古典文學中，主角經常經歷一場轉變性的心理歷程。)

meaning: 保護主義的；保護主義者
example: The mercantile state imposed strict protectionist tariffs on imported woolen commodities to insulate domestic craftspeople. (商業國家對進口的毛織商品徵收嚴格的保護主義關稅，以隔離保護國內的手工藝人。)
Earth's dynamic magnetosphere acts as a vital celestial protector, shielding atmospheric gas molecules from solar winds. (地球動態的磁層扮演著至關重要的天體保護者角色，保護大氣氣體分子免受太陽風的傷害。)
The Proterozoic eon witnessed the stabilization of continents and the initial rise of multicellular life. (元古代見證了大陸的穩定以及多細胞生物的最初興起。)
The atomic number of an element is determined exclusively by the number of protons contained within its nucleus. (元素的原子序數完全由其原子核內所含的質子數量決定。)
Xerophytic desert plants often feature thick, waxy needles that protrude horizontally to catch condensation. (旱生沙漠植物通常長有肥厚、具蠟質的針葉，這些針葉水平伸出以捕捉凝結的水分。)
The university president proudly announced that three faculty members had been awarded prestigious international research grants. (大學校長自豪地宣布，三位教職員榮獲了享譽國際的知名研究資助。)

meaning: 普洛威頓斯 (地名)；天意；遠見
example: The textile industrialist built a massive steam-powered spinning mill near Providence, Rhode Island, boosting urbanization. (這位紡織工業家在羅德島州的普洛威頓斯附近建造了一座大型蒸汽動力紡紗廠，促進了城市化。)

meaning: 地方風尚；偏狹；地方主義
example: The cultural diffusion of centralized metropolitan text legal networks worked to eliminate rural tribal provincialism. (集權大都市文字法律網絡的文化傳播，起到消除了農村部落地方主義（偏狹）的作用。)
Tree rings serve as a reliable climate proxy, offering indirect measurements of rainfall from centuries ago. (年輪可作為可靠的氣候替代資料，提供了數百年前降雨量的間接測量。)
It is considered financially prudent to maintain an emergency savings fund equivalent to six months of living expenses. (維持相當於六個月生活費的緊急儲蓄基金，在財務上被認為是明智的。)
Sea otters utilize heavy rocks to pry tightly interlocked mollusks from underwater granite walls. (海獺利用沉重的石頭，從水下的花崗岩壁上撬開緊密鎖定的軟體動物。)
Sigmund Freud founded the field of psychoanalysis, focusing on how the unconscious mind influences human behavior. (西格蒙德·佛洛伊德創立了精神分析領域，專注於潛意識如何影響人類行為。)
The psychodynamic perspective posits that unconscious motivations strongly dictate conscious adult behavior. (心理動力學觀點認為，潛意識的動機強烈地支配著意識中的成年人行為。)
Sociologists argue that crowding inside industrial tenements was psychologically harmful to child development. (社會學家認為，擁擠在工業廉租公寓內部對於兒童發展在心理上是有害的。)
The pterosaur was the first vertebrate group to evolve powered flight, ruling Mesozoic skies. (翼龍是第一個演化出動力飛行的無脊椎動物群，統治著中生代的天空。)

meaning: 普埃布洛（美洲原住民村落）
example: The multi-story stone dwellings of the ancestral Pueblo people were built directly into the canyon alcoves. (祖傳普埃布洛人的多層石造住宅是直接建造在峽谷的凹處中。)
The introduction of the Pullman sleeping car revolutionized long-distance rail travel in the United States. (普爾曼臥鋪車廂的引進，徹底改變了美國的長途鐵路旅行。)
The manufacturing of ceramic glaze requires the systematic pulverization of mineral silicate and calcite ores. (陶瓷釉料的製造需要將礦物矽酸鹽與方解石礦石進行系統化的粉碎（研磨成粉）。)
The predatory osprey relies on sharp, curved talons to puncture the tough scales of marine fish caught near seabed surfaces. (捕食性的魚鷹依賴銳利、彎曲的趾爪，來刺穿在海床表面附近捕捉的海魚的堅硬鱗片。)
The municipal water infrastructure relies on continuous chemical purification to remove industrial toxic runoff. (城市水資源基礎設施依賴持續的化學淨化，以清除工業有毒逕流。)
The puritan religious sect rejected the mercantile commercialism and theatrical entertainment of the metropolis. (清教徒宗教派別拒絕了大都市的商業重商主義與劇場娛樂。)

meaning: 清教徒式的；道德極嚴格的
example: His grandfather had a puritanical view on entertainment and leisure. (他的祖父對娛樂和休閒持有嚴格的清教徒式觀點。)
As the sun began to set, the sky turned a beautiful purplish hue over the distant mountains. (當太陽開始下山時，遠山之上的天空染上了一抹美麗的微紫色彩。)
The lead researcher purposefully omitted the statistical outliers to focus the analysis on the primary trends. (首席研究員故意省去了統計異常值，以便將分析聚焦在主要趨勢上。)
The imagist poets purposely abandoned flowery descriptions, choosing instead to communicate stark, precise visual imagery. (意象派詩人故意地（蓄意地）放棄了華麗的描述，轉而選擇傳達質樸、精確的視覺意象。)
In warm and humid environments, the natural process of putrefaction occurs with accelerated speed. (在溫暖潮濕的環境中，自然的腐敗過程會以加速的速度發生。)

meaning: 接受能力；敏銳的接受性

Early cinematic documentarians utilized sequenced photographic sleeve frames to recreate realistic simulations of physical locomotion. (早期的電影紀錄片工作者利用序列化的攝影套筒畫面，來重現（重新創造）物理移動的寫實模擬。)

meaning: 週期性發生的；反覆出現的

The eastern redbud is a native angiosperm tree that produces vibrant pink blossoms inside the temperate forest understory. (東部紫荊是一種原生被子植物樹木，在溫帶森林林下植物層內部開出鮮豔的粉紅色花朵。)

Subsurface groundwater runoff can pass deep into limestone karst aquifers and reenter surface river channels miles downstream. (地表下地下水逕流能深入石灰岩喀斯特含水層，並在數英里下游重新進入地表河道。)

meaning: 定居；居住；住院醫生實習期

meaning: 記憶力強的、具保持力的

meaning: 重新裝備；調整（以適應新需求）
example: The manufacturing plant had to temporarily shut down to retool its assembly line for electric vehicle production. (這家製造廠不得不暫時停工，以重新調整其裝配線來生產電動車。)
Sedentary agriculturalist groups built cistern systems to capture precious rainwater runoff for systematic irrigation reuse. (定居的農業勞動者群體建造了蓄水池系統，以收集珍貴的雨水逕流用於系統化的灌溉再利用。)

meaning: 透露內情地；具啟發性地
example: The fossil footprint layers show revealingly how extinct predatory theropods coordinated dynamic hunting packs across mudflats. (化石足跡層具啟發性地（透露內情地）展示了已滅絕的捕食性獸腳類恐龍，如何在泥灘上協調動態的狩獵群體。)
Many indigenous agrarian groups revere supernatural entities linked with seasonal rainfall and soil mineralization. (許多原住民農業群體崇敬（尊敬）與季節性降雨及土壤礦化作用相關的超自然實體。)
The museum curator handled the historic artifact reverently, wearing protective cotton gloves to prevent damage. (博物館館長虔誠地處理這件歷史文物，戴著防護棉手套以防止損壞。)
Magnetic reversal records preserved inside oceanic basalt strata confirm that Earth's magnetic orientation flips periodically. (保存在大海玄武岩地層內部的磁場反轉記錄證實，地球的磁場方向會定期翻轉。)

meaning: 可逆的；可反轉的；兩面穿的
example: Many physical chemical changes are entirely reversible under specific temperature and pressure conditions. (在特定的溫度與壓力條件下，許多物理化學變化是完全可逆的。)
The municipal coalition led the cultural revitalization of abandoned metropolis arcades, transforming lofts into artisan shops. (地方聯盟領導了廢棄大都市拱廊街的文化復興，將閣樓轉化為工匠店鋪。)
Federal funding grants allowed the local coalition to revitalize abandoned urban arcades into artisan markets. (聯邦資金撥款容許地方聯盟，將廢棄的城市拱廊街復興為工匠市場。)
The transportation authority decided to permanently revoke the driver's license following multiple traffic violations. (交通主管機關在多次交通違規後，決定永久撤銷該駕駛的執照。)
The continuous, rhythmical pounding of tidal waves shaped the uneven granite coastlines over geological timescales. (潮汐波浪持續、有節奏的敲擊，在地質時間尺度上塑造了崎嶇不平的花崗岩海岸線。)
The historic cathedral is richly decorated with Renaissance frescoes and intricate stained-glass windows. (這座歷史悠久的大教堂豐富地裝飾著文藝復興時期的壁畫和錯綜複雜的花窗玻璃。)
The ecological richness of tropical rainforests is unmatched, holding half of Earth's biological species. (熱帶雨林的生態豐富度無與倫比，容納了地球上的一半生物物種。)
Molten liquid magma escapes through the oceanic rift zone, solidifying into dark layers of intrusive basalt rock. (熔融的液態岩漿透過海洋裂谷帶逸出，凝固成黑暗的侵入玄武岩岩石層。)
The community was moved by his righteous campaign for equal rights. (社區被他爭取平等權利的正義運動所感動。)
The structural rigidity of the marine invertebrate's protective skeleton allows it to survive extreme tidal crashing wave zones. (海洋無脊椎動物保護性骨骼的結構剛性（僵硬），使其能在極端的潮汐衝擊波區域中存活。)
Ancient Egyptian reliefs conformed rigidly to artistic formulas of frontality, ensuring shoulders always faced forward. (古埃及浮雕僵硬地（嚴格地）符合正面性的藝術公式，確保肩膀始終面向正前方。)
Warm sunny weather throughout August helped the vineyard grapes ripen perfectly ahead of the annual harvest. (整個八月溫暖晴朗的天氣，有助於葡萄園的葡萄在年度採收前完美成熟。)
The shipbuilders utilized thousands of steel rivets to reinforce the hull of the historical ocean liner. (造船廠使用了數千個鋼鉚釘來加固這艘歷史悠久的遠洋客輪的船體。)
Civil engineers packed coarse gravel boulders tightly to stabilize the mechanical roadbed structure of the midwest railway. (土木工程師將粗糙的礫石巨石緊密壓實，以穩定中西部鐵路的機械路基結構。)
The western rodeo expanded as a popular entertainment format, celebrating the handcraft skills of the frontier rancher. (西部牛仔競技表演作為一種受歡迎的娛樂形式而擴張，慶祝拓荒牧場主的手工藝技能。)
The culinary delicacy known as caviar consists of salted roe harvested exclusively from sturgeon species. (被稱為魚子醬的佳餚是由專門從鱘魚身上採集並加鹽醃製的魚卵組成。)
The historical novelist romantically depicted medieval court life, occasionally omitting its harsh realities. (這位歷史小說家浪漫地描繪了中世紀的宮廷生活，偶爾忽略了其殘酷的現實。)
Romanticism rejected the mechanical rigidity of industrialism, prioritizing emotional catharsis and untamed nature. (浪漫主義拒絕了工業制度的機械式僵硬，優先考慮情感宣洩與不受馴服的大自然。)
Bats gather in dark caves to roost during daylight hours, minimizing exposure to predatory birds. (蝙蝠在白天的時間聚集在黑暗的洞穴中棲息，將暴露於捕食性鳥類的風險降到最低。)

meaning: 玫瑰色的、樂觀的、美好的
example: Despite economic headwinds, the financial analyst presented a surprisingly rosy outlook for the technology sector. (儘管面臨經濟逆風，金融分析師仍對科技產業提出了出人意料的樂觀美好前景。)
The rotational movement of the Earth causes day and night. (地球的自轉運動造成了白天和黑夜。)
Linguistic training before writing systems arose relied on oral rote sequencing to perpetuate historical epic narratives. (文字系統興起之前的語言訓練依賴口頭死記硬背的串聯，以使歷史史詩敘事永存。)
Retreating glaciers transport heterogeneous till layers, leaving a much rougher textural landscape across plains. (後退的冰河運送異質的冰磧層，在平原上留下了更為粗糙的（更崎嶇的）紋理景觀。)
The structural roughness of the sandstone bedrock surface dictates its intense mechanical friction against moving glacial till blocks. (砂岩基岩表面的結構粗糙度（不平整），主導了其對移動冰磧塊的強烈機械摩擦。)

meaning: 基本的；初步的；發育不全的
example: Paleolithic hominids manufactured rudimentary stone scrapers to process animal hides for clothing. (舊石器時代的原始人類製造基本的石製刮削器，以處理動物皮革來製作衣服。)

meaning: 瘤胃（反芻動物的第一個胃）
example: Inside the bovine rumen, millions of symbiotic microorganisms actively decompose complex plant starches. (在牛科動物的瘤胃內部，數百萬個共生微生物積極地分解複雜的植物澱粉。)
Bovine mammals rely on symbiotic microbes micro-infestations to ruminate steppe grasses rich in cellulose. (牛科哺乳動物依賴共生微生物的感染，來反芻富含纖維素的大草原牧草。)
Agricultural runoff containing synthetic fertilizers can cause devastating ecological imbalances in nearby lakes. (含有合成肥料的農業逕流可能會對附近湖泊造成破壞性的生態失衡。)
The cabin had a rustic charm with its wooden logs and stone fireplace. (這座小屋以其木原木和石頭壁爐展現出鄉村的魅力。)
The pioneer farmers cultivated hardy grains like rye across poor midcontinent soils unsuited for delicate maize crops. (拓荒農民在不適合嬌貴玉米作物的貧瘠中部大陸土壤上，耕作了像黑麥這樣耐寒的穀物。)

meaning: 索克族 (美洲原住民)；生物囊
example: The Sac nation maintained a sedentary lifestyle, practicing small-scale horticulture along the fertile river lowlands. (索克族維持著定居的生活方式，在肥沃的河流低地沿線進行小規模的園藝耕作。)
The ancient tribe performed a sacrificial ritual to appease the gods. (古代部落舉行祭祀儀式以平息神明。)
Subsurface nuclear waste canisters must be firmly encased inside granite bedrock formations to be stored safely. (地表下核廢料筒必須被堅固地包裝在花崗岩基岩構造內部，以便被安全地儲存。)
The ancient community frequently sought political and philosophical guidance from the respected village sage. (這個古代社區經常向備受尊敬的村莊智者尋求政治和哲學上的指導。)
The Sahara was not always a desert; geological evidence shows it experienced lush green periods in the past. (撒哈拉並不總是沙漠；地質證據顯示它過去曾祖經歷過綠意盎然的時期。)
The report points out the salient features of the new economic package. (該報告指出新經濟方案的顯著特點。)
Evaporation converts isolated landlocked basins into highly saline lakes that exclude most freshwater fish. (蒸發將孤立的內陸盆地轉化為高度含鹽的湖泊，從而排除了大多數淡水魚。)
Evaporation increases the salinity of landlocked lakes, making them hostile environments for most fish species. (蒸發增加了內陸湖泊的鹽度，使其成為大多數魚類無法生存的惡劣環境。)
Persistent overirrigation in hyper-arid landscapes triggers extensive topsoil salinization, leaving hostile mineral crusts. (在極度乾旱景觀中持續的過度灌溉會引發廣泛的表土鹽鹼化，留下無法生長作物的礦物地殼。)
Marine invertebrates possess specialized osmotic adaptations to survive inside hyper-saline saltwater ecosystems. (海洋無脊椎動物具備特化的滲透適應能力，以在高鹽度的鹽水生態系統中存活。)
Due to its porous nature, sandstone often acts as a natural filtering system for migrating groundwater. (由於其多孔的特性，砂岩通常充當流動地下水的天然過濾系統。)
Linguists trace the structural evolution of Indo-European tongues by analyzing ancient inscriptions compiled in Sanskrit. (語言學家藉由分析用梵文編纂的古代銘文，來追蹤印歐語言的結構演化。)
The sticky sap secreted by cedar trees functions to ward off wood-boring insects and fungal infestations. (雪松樹分泌的黏稠植物汁液，起到驅除鑽木昆蟲與真菌侵染的作用。)
Her engagement ring was set with a brilliant blue sapphire. (她的訂婚戒指嵌有一顆璀璨的藍寶石。)
The critic’s sardonic remarks offended many individuals in the audience. (影評人嘲諷的話語激怒了觀眾中的許多人。)

meaning: 中士；警官（通常拼作 sergeant）
example: The police sargeant instructed his team to secure the perimeter before allowing the investigators inside. (警官指示他的團隊在允許調查人員進入之前先封鎖周邊區域。)
The candidate wore a bright red sash across her shoulder during the commencement ceremony. (該候選人在畢業典禮上肩披一條鮮紅色的飾帶。)
Parent birds must forage relentlessly across forest understories to sate the voracious appetite of each altricial nestling. (鳥類親代必須在森林林下植物層跨度間無休止地覓食，以滿足（使心滿意足）每隻晚熟性雛鳥貪婪的食慾。)
The writer used political satire to critique social inequality without facing direct government censorship. (該作家利用政治諷刺來批判社會不平等，而免於面臨政府的直接審查。)
The playwright composed satiric dramas that utilized sharp wit to critique the corruption of urban mercantile monopolies. (這位劇作家創作了諷刺戲劇，利用尖銳的機智來批判城市商業壟斷的腐敗。)
The local market has reached a point of absolute saturation, making it difficult for new startups to compete. (當地市場已達到絕對飽和的狀態，使得新創公司難以競爭。)
Saturn features an extensive, dynamic ring system composed primarily of billions of ice and rock particles. (土星擁有一個廣泛、動態的環系統，主要由數十億個冰塊和岩石顆粒組成。)
The playful comedian was loved for her saucy wit and sharp political humor that challenged authority figures. (這位愛開玩笑的喜劇演員因其俏皮的機智與挑戰權威人物的尖銳政治幽默而受到喜愛。)
The couple decided to saunter along the beach during the warm sunset. (這對夫婦決定在溫暖的落日餘暉中沿著海灘漫步。)
The African savannah is a highly dynamic biome shaped by seasonal rainfall fluctuations and migratory grazing herds. (非洲大草原是一個高度動態的生物群系，受到季節性降雨波動與遷徙食草獸群的塑造。)
The fjords of Scandinavia were carved out by massive glaciers during successive Pleistocene ice ages. (斯堪地那維亞的峽灣是由更新世接連的冰河時期中巨大的冰河所雕琢出來的。)
Due to low annual rain deposits, vegetation inside hyper-arid semiarid shrublands remains exceptionally sparse and scant. (由於年降雨量沉積低，極度乾旱的半乾旱灌木地內部的植被保持異常稀疏與微薄（不足）。)
The prehistoric opportunist mammal functioned chiefly as a scavenger, feeding on the remains left by top predators. (這隻史前機會主義哺乳動物主要充當食腐動物，以頂級捕食者留下的殘骸為食。)
The electrical engineering technician consulted the detailed schematic diagram to repair the complex radar hardware. (電機工程技術人員查閱了詳細的電路原理圖，以修復複雜的雷達硬體。)
The professor published a scholarly article that thoroughly analyzed the socio-economic impacts of the industrial revolution. (這位教授發表了一篇學術論文，徹底分析了工業革命對社會經濟的影響。)
The historical museum reconstructed a late nineteenth-century schoolroom complete with vintage wooden desks. (這座歷史博物館重建了一個19世紀晚期的教室，並配有復古的木製課桌椅。)
The efficacy of the newly formulated medical compound has been scientifically verified through rigorous trials. (新調配的醫療化合物之功效，已經透過嚴格的臨床試驗得到了科學地驗證。)
Many experts chose to scoff at his radical scientific theories initially. (許多專家最初選擇嘲笑他激進的科學理論。)
Extrusive liquid basalt magma breakouts can quickly scorch and decompose neighboring broadleaf forest understory flora. (噴出的液態玄武岩岩漿爆發，會迅速燒焦（使枯萎）並分解鄰近的闊葉林林下植物層植物群。)
The elitist art critic cast a scornful eye over the amateur painter's landscape canvas. (這位精英主義的藝術評論家對業餘畫家的風景畫布投去了輕蔑的目光。)
Rescue teams continue to scour the dense mountainous wilderness for the missing exploration group. (救援隊繼續在茂密的山區荒野中搜尋失蹤的探險小組。)
The abandoned orchard was full of scraggly apple trees that had long stopped producing viable fruit. (這座被廢棄的果園裡到處都是蓬亂瘦弱的蘋果樹，這些樹早就停止產出可食用的果實了。)
The natural scrubbiness of the hillside vegetation made it an ideal habitat for specific ground-nesting birds. (山坡植被天然的灌木叢生狀態，使其成為特定在地面築巢鳥類的理想棲息地。)
The detective assumed a scruffy appearance to blend in inconspicuously with the urban underground community. (偵探換上了邋遢的外表，以不引人注目地融入城市地下社群。)
The accountant was scrupulous in keeping track of all expenditures. (這位會計師在記錄所有開支時都一絲不苟。)
Modern marine biologists utilize advanced scuba equipment to study invertebrate communities inside deep coral reef systems. (現代海洋生物學家利用先進的水肺設備，來研究深層珊瑚礁系統內部的無脊椎動物群落。)
A brief scuffle broke out between the fans outside the stadium. (體育場外粉絲之間爆發了短暫的扭打。)
The artist spent months trying to sculpt a statue out of marble. (藝術家花了幾個月的時間試圖用大理石雕刻一座雕像。)
